notes.title: Eight-Pointed Star Missing Audio Fix
notes.notes:
It has come to my attention that there was a missing "Eight-pointed star" audio file; it was initially removed from the game's content assumed unused and due to the large file size.

The .ogg and .m4a versions of this file that RPG Maker MV requires has been added back into the latest Build-08 of the game. [i]Xere strikes again![/i]
